_comment: Lane-private pins for the multi-turn views ctlstop64s<k> (k in 1..3) of target qwen35_4b: per seed, the two
batch-64 control fits whose early stopping read the control held-out pool (constv2ctl2-full__lora_r4_ce,
constv2ctl2-full__psr_ce_all) and the two constitution-minus-control differences built from them
(constv2-mix-full__lora_r4_ce_minus_ctl, a lora_subtraction; constv2-mix-full__psr_ce_all_minus_ctl, a
psr_paired_write), served on the instruct checkpoint at the production cell spellings.
WHY A PRIVATE FILE rather than entries in configs/sdfbase_full22_pins.json: these are comparison objects, not the
published seed replicates, and nothing here is appended to any shared surface. The roster that consumes these
pins is configs/sdfbase_full22_roster_ctlstop_eb64.yaml, selected by the F22_ROSTER override, through the
cross-bank pin form {pins, pin} (make_bank_view.plan_pin_entry, mt_serving_up._pin_form_sha,
jobplan.object_id_for with pins_root).
KEYED BY SEED: the staged ids carry ctlstop64s<k>__ because the CELL id is the production one (the seed lives in the
view and the staged object, never in the cell id); the prefix is the one the objects bank maps to campaign
reseed_ctlstop with no replicate label.
`source` is spelled RELATIVE to exp/objects and `bank` is its first component (make_bank_view.objects_root_of /
plan_pin_entry). The builder resolves the staged copy at <objects root>/ctlstop_eb64/qwen35_4b/cells/<staged_id>
and requires this `source` view path to exist and resolve to that same directory. Each staged copy holds
object.pt, its one identity sidecar and staged_from.json.
served_layer: the LoRA kinds (lora_all, lora_subtraction) store the 8 layers [3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, 31]
(site o_proj_out, served == stored), so 3 is the first served block; the PSR kinds (psr, psr_paired_write) store
all 32 layers, so 0. The builder holds the value by membership in the blob's served layers.
identity_sidecar: train_budget_meta.json for the two fitted controls, derived_meta.json for the two differences,
which also carry derived_id (the object's own derived id, equal to its cell id).
Each sha was re-hashed from the staged object.pt and held equal to its sidecar's object_sha256 and to
staged_from.json's; every difference's recorded parents are the seed's published constitution object
(configs/sdfbase_full22_pins.json base64s<k>__constv2-mix-full__<arm>) and the seed's control pinned here. No
sha here equals any entry of configs/sdfbase_full22_pins.json.
